paper_metadata.title: A VLSI CMOS Delay Oriented Waveform Converter for Polyphase Frequency Synthesizer
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, we present a waveform converter implemented on a 0.25m CMOS technology using a dedicated design methodology (Delay Oriented Design). The circuit converts a square wave signal in both in-phase and quadrature-phase sinusoidal differential outputs. It also multiplies the frequency by seven. The output frequency range of this converter extends from 1.05 GHz up to 2.17 GHz. This converter is dedicated for the design of a third-generation mobile phone synthesizer using a double-loop architecture. For an output frequency of 2 GHz, Fig. 1.
